title: Validation, soak and explicit rollout decision

measurement_commits.note: the repetitions, the soak, the limits and the workload matrix were measured with the tool at the campaign commit; the platform matrix was re-measured with the tool at the second commit, after the wording of one note was corrected, and the numbers are the same in both runs

fixture.identity: the 2026-10-19 current fixture; the tool verifies the manifest's content hash before every native run, so every number below is tied to this fixture and to no other
fixture.note: the fixture was not disturbed during this issue: the recorded 4,036-file loss and the 4,006-file authorized recovery are unchanged, and no restore was needed

endpoint.viewport: QQuickWindow.afterRendering render-callback proxy (embedded offscreen scene). NOT presentation FPS, NOT input-to-present, NOT scanout.
endpoint.application: Synchronous QWidget.grab()/readback probe. NOT presentation FPS, NOT input-to-present, NOT scanout.
endpoint.unmeasured: presentation latency, input-to-present latency and scanout are NOT measured by anything in this record; no grab or readback timing is renamed as input-to-present

budget.repetitions: at least 5 matched, interleaved; 6 were run
budget.soak: two sessions of repeated travel, forecast-time and zoom changes: the interleaved session inside the repetition session and a long session run to the stated time cap; the criterion and the caps were stated before the runs: 20,000 steps and a 660 s cap for the interleaved session, 40,000 steps and a 900 s cap for the long session
budget.native_attempts: the viewport's own gate was run once before the change and once after; every measurement is a whole native process of the same tool

repetitions.matched: each repetition is a whole native process with its own worker thread, field store, sampling memo and staging provider, on the same fixture and the same workload: 120 pan inputs, 24 anchored zoom inputs and 18 forecast-time crossings
repetitions.interleaved: the repetitions were interleaved with the soak inside one session: three repetitions ran before the soak and three after it, so a drift in the machine's state is spread over the repetitions instead of accumulating in the last one. The wall-clock offsets below make the order visible.

criterion.statement: over the last three thirds of the curve the retained field store bytes agree within 2% of the last third's median, and no declared budget is exceeded at any point of the curve
criterion.note: the 2% is this issue's own declared criterion, not a number derived from recorded evidence; the gate reports it as unratified

sessions.name: interleaved
sessions.note: the soak that ran inside the repetition session: the repetitions were split around it, three before and three after

sessions.name: long
sessions.note: the long session: the same workload, run to the stated time cap so the plateau is observed over more than ten minutes of continuous travel, forecast-time and zoom changes

cold_load.note: a fresh session: no resident field, no warm store, one preparation and the first ready presentation

coverage_miss.note: the camera leaves the resident field's window: the viewport must show the loading state and hide the stale weather, then recover

interval_crossing.note: the forecast instant leaves the resident time window: a new field must be prepared, so this is a preparation limit and not a scrub limit

fill.loading_state_source: the viewport's weather state: the layer is published from the same resident field as the barbs
fill.fallback_note: the viewport's layers have no per-layer CPU fallback; the retained CPU fallback is the application's CPU map renderer

barbs.loading_state_source: the viewport's weather state: the layer is published from the same resident field as the barbs
barbs.fallback_note: the viewport's layers have no per-layer CPU fallback; the retained CPU fallback is the application's CPU map renderer

chart.fallback_note: the viewport's layers have no per-layer CPU fallback; the retained CPU fallback is the application's CPU map renderer

cpu_fallback.where: the application's own CPU map renderer
cpu_fallback.proof: the validation gate replays the same scenario on the same fixture with the CPU renderer: 24 of 24 frames had a prepared wind view current for the view, the renderer status was the CPU path, and the run reported no overlay error

cells.note: the saved selection of 22 forecasts spans several models and centres over the same area; the viewport's source order and its coverage policy are the application's own
a different source set in its own session; the model's source set is bound when the session is created, so a source change is a new session, not a step inside one

a demand for a region no selected forecast covers; the viewport must show the loading state and hide the stale weather instead of painting a neighbour's value. The all-missing payload's zero-alpha rule is measured in the interaction session's fill observations
the over_land=False path: the field must be prepared at the shoreline resolution tier and the viewport must still serve current weather

NOT COVERED. The independent viewport has no marine layer: it renders the wind barbs, the numerical fill and the chart layer only. A marine-heavy workload exercises the application's marine pipeline, which this vehicle does not contain, so no result is claimed for it.

NOT COVERED. The independent viewport is a single standalone view; the application's two-map layout (the main map and the log map) is the legacy path, which this vehicle does not contain, so no result is claimed for it.

platform_matrix.recorded_from: the campaign's platform section, re-measured after the wording of the OpenGL cell's note was corrected; the numbers are the same in both runs

cells.note: the widget is resized while it is presented; the viewport re-derives the demand for the new size and keeps the weather current
the host the measurement ran on, with the scene graph's own backend name and the device pixel ratio
NOT COVERED. This host runs at a fixed device pixel ratio of 2.0; a screen change that alters the ratio cannot be exercised here, and the viewport records no handling for it. No result is claimed.
NOT COVERED. A Metal device loss cannot be induced on this host, and the viewport records no context-loss handler, so no result is claimed. The scene graph's own recovery is not the viewport's.

the OpenGL RHI backend, selected with QSG_RHI_BACKEND, in its own native process: the viewport loads and the layers' shaders compile, but the framebuffer readback returns an empty image (0 of the total pixels are painted), so the numerical fill's pixel and value evidence is NOT available on that backend with this instrumentation. The interaction's continuous-weather check held in one run of this cell and did not hold in another, so the OpenGL backend is not claimed to reproduce the Metal result.

the Vulkan RHI backend, selected with QSG_RHI_BACKEND, in its own native process: the viewport's cold load timed out, so the viewport does not present there. This is a negative result, not a coverage claim.

Qt's software renderer, selected with QT_QUICK_BACKEND, in its own native process: the viewport's cold load timed out, so the viewport does not present there. This is a negative result, not a coverage claim.

application_matrix.command: python tools/benchmark_startup_rendering.py --snapshot <snap> --map-renderer gpu --scenarios <all ten> --frames 24 --repeats 1 --cpu-fallback-probe --output <file>, with the gate's own environment (GWR_GPU_WEATHER=1)
application_matrix.note: the validation gate's --full profile is the app-side matrix, but the runner's timeout is capped at 120 s and that profile needs more than it: the --full attempt was killed at 110 s after two of the thirty runs, and the tool's own checkpoint file records them. The matrix was therefore run directly with the same tool, the same fixture and the gate's own environment, and the gate itself was run before and after the change

cpu_fallback.note: the retained CPU fallback: the application's own CPU renderer, on the same fixture, the same saved selection and the same scenario as the GPU run

gates.note: the application's default path is unchanged by this work: the viewport is a standalone entry point behind its own flags and the application does not import it

negative_results.result: the OpenGL RHI backend does not reproduce the Metal result
negative_results.detail: with QSG_RHI_BACKEND=opengl the viewport loads and the layers' shaders compile, but the framebuffer readback returns an empty image (0 of 2,520,000 pixels painted), so the numerical fill's pixel and value evidence is not available on that backend with this instrumentation

negative_results.result: the viewport does not present on the Vulkan RHI backend
negative_results.detail: with QSG_RHI_BACKEND=vulkan the viewport's cold load timed out (15 s) in its own native process

negative_results.result: the viewport does not present on Qt's software renderer
negative_results.detail: with QT_QUICK_BACKEND=software the viewport's cold load timed out (15 s) in its own native process

negative_results.result: the interaction's dispatch lateness reaches 78.7 ms
negative_results.detail: the sustained pan's dispatch lateness has a p95 of 48.7 ms and a maximum of 78.7 ms across the six repetitions, against a p50 of 3.4 ms. The GUI thread competes with the field preparation. This is a dispatch-latency proxy, not an input-to-present latency, and no recorded acceptance bound applies to it
it fails on the base commit 5917c3a as well, because the mocked stager has no field_store_statistics; it is not caused by this issue and it is not fixed by it

negative_results.result: the two disclosed budget overruns stand
negative_results.detail: issue #65's first pass spent eight native attempts against a budget of three and issue #69 spent thirteen against three; neither is repaired by this issue

negative_results.result: the soak's plateau criterion is not ratified
negative_results.detail: the 2% tolerance is this issue's own declared criterion; no recorded evidence sets a plateau bound, so the gate reports it as unratified and it does not affect any verdict

negative_results.result: the three separate limits have no ratified bound
negative_results.detail: the recorded preparation costs are measurements of other scripts, not acceptance bounds, so the cold load, the coverage-miss recovery and the interval-crossing recovery are reported as unratified

recommendation.statement: Keep the independent viewport experimental and behind its own flags. Do not switch the application's default weather interaction path to it on this evidence.
why: the interaction contract survived six matched, interleaved repetitions: 0 loading inputs in every phase of every repetition, continuous_weather true in all six, the fill's value error at 5.96e-08 and its placement error at 4.17e-07 in all six

the long session's memory curve plateaus: the field store settles at 29,610,216 bytes of its 128 MiB ceiling with 12 fields and no eviction, and the sampling memo at 15,627,216 bytes of its 16 MiB ceiling, over 21,216 steps and 900.0 s
the three separate limits are each reported on their own, and the viewport recovers from both a coverage miss and an interval crossing with honest loading and no stale weather
the retained CPU fallback is proven to work: 24 of 24 frames current on the application's own CPU renderer
why_not: visual fidelity is still failed and deferred; nothing here is a visual verdict
the presentation endpoint is a render-callback proxy: presentation latency and input-to-present latency are unmeasured

the platform matrix has gaps that are reported, not closed: a device-pixel-ratio change and a Metal device loss cannot be exercised on this host, and the OpenGL backend does not reproduce the Metal result
the workload matrix has two cells the vehicle does not contain at all: a marine-heavy workload and the application's two-map view
the soak's plateau criterion and the three separate limits are unratified: the numbers are reported, but no recorded acceptance bound backs them
does_not_cover: the default application's own start-up and draw path
next_concrete_steps: ratify the plateau bound and the three limit bounds against recorded evidence, or record them as unratified deliberately
measure the presentation endpoint with an instrument that can see the compositor, before any default switch is considered
close the marine and two-map cells, or record them as out-of-vehicle permanently
decide the OpenGL backend: either support it or record that Metal is the only supported backend
